Non-Bailable Warrant Issued Against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in 2018 Defamation Case

A Delhi court issued a non-bailable warrant against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee on Monday, November 23, 2026, in connection with a 2018 defamation case. The case relates to allegations made in a video titled ‘BJP IT Cell Part II’. The warrant was issued after earlier attempts to secure Rathee's appearance in court failed. The next hearing is scheduled for December 3. The case stems from a complaint filed by Vikas.
